description: This PHP source file defines the UpgraderDataRegistrationAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It implements an API controller that handles POST requests for registering upgrade-related data, utilizing other utility and service classes for data processing and system configuration.

classes.name: UpgraderDataRegistrationAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for handling upgrade data registration requests in the OrangeHRM system. It manages the registration data submission and system event queuing during the upgrade process.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to initiate registration data submission during an upgrade. It collects registration data, sends it via the service, logs system events if applicable, and returns a success or failure message.
